messages:
Maya R: quick async standup — model onboarding + evals
- yesterday: finished staging deploy for vicuna-13b-q4a (quantized) and wired model metadata into the catalog. added tags: `quantized, q4a, vicuna-13b`
- blocker: long-context evals (8k+) are OOMing on the dedicated 80GB job, trace shows KV cache growth spikes after ~3k tokens. tried bumping batch_size->1 but still fails.
- today: try the new runtime flag `--kv-slab=dynamic`, re-run full eval suite with 3 seeds, and open PR for model card + perf notes.

Oliver C: thanks Maya — can you paste the error snippet? if it's KV cache growth maybe related to the kernel selection path we landed on last week.

Maya R: here's the tail of the crash log:```Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/srv/runtime/infer.py", line 482, in step
    cache.write(kv)
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory when allocating tensor of size 1.2GiB
```
I also see this in the serving logs: `selected_kernel: attn_fused_fp16` around the same time.

Samir D: fyi the prompt sets for long-context were missing the `context_id` field in a few cases — that caused extra prefixing in the eval harness which ballooned sequence lengths. I fixed 3 prompt files and pushed to `eval-prompt-sets/long-context` :thumbsup:

Nora P: heads up — if you need a quick canary with a different kernel path, we have a free slot on `dedicated-canary-2` (eu-west). ping @eng-runtime channel and I can reserve for an hour. Also we should add an automatic fallback policy in the rollout: if OOM on >2% requests, fallback to vicuna-13b-int8.

Maya R: good call. reserving canary now and will try `--kv-slab=dynamic` + `--kernel=attn_blocked` as a config override. will run the eval harness with seeds [42, 1337, 9001].

eval-bot: nightly-eval summary (00:30 UTC): vicuna-13b-q4a (staging) — pass rate 92.3%, rougeL drop vs baseline: -1.6, latency p95: 310ms -> note: long-context subset failed (OOM) on 4/120 cases. Full logs: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/evals/1764012345

Oliver C: can you add a small repro that triggers the OOM? even a 1-off input that reproduces KV cache blowup is helpful for infra debuggers.

Maya R: yes — I'll isolate a minimal prompt and post it here in the next message. also creating the PR for model card now (w/ quantization notes + known long-context limitation).

Samir D: quick QA ask — once staging is stable, can we add these prompt sets to the regression suite so we catch it earlier? I can add them to `regression/long-context` after your repro.

Maya R: absolutely — plan is: repro -> canary run -> if passes, add to regression harness and schedule a small eval job nightly.

Nora P: sounds good. @Maya R when you post the repro tag me and i'll loop in eng-runtime if kernel changes are needed.

Maya R: posted minimal repro gist: https://gist.github.com/maya/0a1b2c3 (input replicates context concat + long system prompt). starting canary run now. will update once finished. :rocket:
